department.instructions: Which team should handle this support ticket?

criteria.billing: double charges, invoices, payments, refunds, subscription price
criteria.technical: bugs, crashes, outages, errors, integration or API problems
criteria.account: login, password reset, two-factor auth, profile or access changes

churn_risk.instructions: Does the customer threaten to cancel, leave, or stop paying?

criteria.A: yes, the customer threatens to cancel or leave
criteria.B: no, the customer does not threaten to cancel or leave

refund_requested.instructions: Is the customer explicitly asking to be refunded or paid back?

criteria.A: yes, a refund or payback is requested
criteria.B: no, no refund or payback is requested
